items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: My mother named Kate said, Kate, fix me something good.

ctx.x: Did you ever play clarinet? Huh?

Did you ever play clarinet? No, I never did, but I loved it. Did you ever try? Well I blowed a few notes on it. It was complicated, you know, and I was so crazy about that cornet, I didn't have time to learn, you know. And I put all my efforts on the trumpet. What other instruments have you ever played? I played the drums. I played the drums. I played that before I played the trumpet, you see. My father was a cornet player, you know. And he didn't allow nobody to touch his instruments. We had a room full of…
What were you going to study? Any particular?
